stem:
Nidhi rolls a bar magnet through a scatter of iron nails on her desk. One end of the magnet is painted yellow.

Where does the magnet attract the nails most strongly?

options.text: Equally at every part of the bar magnet.
Near the two poles at the ends.
Most strongly in the middle and least at the ends.

teacher.key_rationale: A bar magnet attracts magnetic materials most strongly near its two poles. Attraction is not equal everywhere, not strongest in the middle, and not limited to the painted colour.
